ns2:section.sectionText: This course is taught entirely online through compass.illinois.edu. Class will meet ONLY for exams, which are given on the following Tuesdays at 7:00 pm: 9/16, 10/14, 11/11, and 12/16. Students have the option of using ProctorU for exams. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://citl.illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $394.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
